Anima Weapon @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.Item.Kd3YSsNyAgx0RwLe]{Anima Weapon: Lapine Kick}

Anima Morph @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.Item.BYI4zFhJ8k0xJtBw]{Anima Morph: Lapine Kick}

Anima Ability @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.Item.7pfzFjzST0N2KTZk]{Anima Ability: Lapine Kick}

You charge forward and perform a leaping somersault, slamming against a target with your large kicking feet. Perform a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} or a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}; you can Stride before you do. At the end of your Leap, make an Anima Strike. On a hit, you can attempt to [[/act shove]] the creature. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after you’ve made both attacks.

 

Heightened (3rd) When you successfully shove a creature, you shove them an additional 5 feet.

Heightened (8th) When you successfully shove a creature, you shove them an additional 10 feet.
